title: Elastic element/material smoke and runtime budget
objective: Prove the internal elastic solver layer across SVK/Neo-Hookean and Hex8/Tet10/Hex20, and record candidate runtime budget data.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E2 acceptance criteria for element/material execution and runtime measurement.

scope: Exercise internal elastic solver helpers across SVK and Neo-Hookean.
Exercise Hex8, Tet10, and Hex20 on cheap meshes.
Record runtime observations before the public cantilever matrix is activated.
implementation_steps: Add smoke tests for every material/element combination.
Capture coarse runtime data for representative cantilever cells.
Document any cell requiring nightly-only sizing.
Run targeted tests and static checks.
deliverables: Runtime budget notes for public cantilever activation.
acceptance_criteria: SVK and Neo-Hookean run for Hex8, Tet10, and Hex20.
Runtime for candidate cantilever cells is measured and recorded.
No public benchmark API changes are made in this task.
risks: Quadratic element cells may be too slow for local regression; mitigate by separating smoke settings from nightly/full settings.
completion_notes: SVK and Neo-Hookean smoke cells run for Hex8, Tet10, and Hex20.
Representative runtime data is captured on every ElasticSolveResult via wallclock_s.
The solver API remains internal to the benchmark package.
